blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 FMEA 風險評估工具如何應用於充填設備升級，並以 RPN 計算方式（嚴重度 × 發生率 × 偵測率）對 CQA 和 CPP 進行分級。
blocks.en: Understand how the FMEA risk assessment tool is applied to a filling equipment upgrade, and how CQAs and CPPs are ranked using the RPN calculation (severity × occurrence × detection).

blocks.zh: 能解讀 Table 12-9🔍「風險等級評估表」——掌握效力、純度、無菌性、填充量、容器密封完整性各項的風險邏輯與緩解措施。
blocks.en: Be able to read the "risk level assessment table" in Table 12-9🔍, and understand the risk logic and mitigation measures for potency, purity, sterility, fill volume and container closure integrity.

blocks.zh: 理解實驗室幫浦研究（Laboratory Pump Studies）與工程批次（Engineering Runs）的設計目的：在正式 PPQ 前積累充填參數與產品品質基準數據。
blocks.en: Understand the purpose of the design of laboratory pump studies and engineering runs: to build baseline data on filling parameters and product quality before the formal PPQ.

blocks.zh: 掌握 PPQ（製程效能確效）的完整框架：CPP 表、CQA 表、容器密封完整性測試、隔離器消毒週期、媒體填充、煙霧試驗的各自角色。
blocks.en: Know the complete PPQ (process performance qualification) framework: the respective roles of the CPP table, CQA table, container closure integrity testing, isolator decontamination cycle, media fill and smoke studies.

blocks.zh: 理解比較性研究（Comparability Study）的設計邏輯：三個 PPQ 商業批次 vs. 三個歷史批次，依 Table 12-15/16 的預設接受標準進行統計比較。
blocks.en: Understand the design logic of the comparability study: three PPQ commercial batches vs. three historical batches, compared statistically against the predefined acceptance criteria in Tables 12-15/16.

blocks.zh: 掌握 PACMP 後續申報承諾清單（CTD 3.2.P.2.3 至 3.2.A.1）——這是向監管機關展示「我們說到做到」的書面承諾結構。
blocks.en: Know the list of PACMP follow-up filing commitments (CTD 3.2.P.2.3 to 3.2.A.1): the written commitment structure that shows the regulator "we do what we say".

blocks.zh: Risk Assessment & Mitigation Plan — 風險評估與緩解計畫
blocks.en: Risk Assessment & Mitigation Plan

blocks.zh: 風險評估解析
blocks.en: Risk Assessment Analysis

blocks.zh: 核心概念：兩層風險評估架構
blocks.en: Key Concept: A Two-Layer Risk Assessment Structure

blocks.zh: 這份 PACMP 的風險評估分兩個維度：廠房設施層面（人員/物料流向、差壓、更衣室設計）和產品/製程層面（CQA、CPP 影響）。兩者缺一不可。
blocks.en: The risk assessment in this PACMP has two dimensions: the facility level (personnel/material flow, pressure differentials, gowning room design) and the product/process level (impact on CQAs and CPPs). Neither can be omitted.

blocks.zh: 廠房評估確保 GMP 基礎設施沒有盲點；產品評估確保藥品品質不受影響。監管機關審查時，這兩份評估都會被仔細檢視。
blocks.en: The facility assessment ensures there are no blind spots in the GMP infrastructure; the product assessment ensures drug quality is not affected. Regulators will examine both assessments closely during review.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：FMEA 在 ICH Q9 框架下的應用
blocks.en: Key Concept: Applying FMEA within the ICH Q9 Framework

blocks.zh: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis（FMEA）是 ICH Q9 推薦的風險評估工具之一。它的邏輯是：列出所有可能的失效模式 → 評估每個模式的嚴重度（Severity）、發生率（Occurrence）、偵測率（Detection）→ 計算 RPN → 依 RPN 優先排序緩解措施。
blocks.en: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) is one of the risk assessment tools recommended in ICH Q9. Its logic is: list all possible failure modes → assess the severity, occurrence and detection of each mode → calculate the RPN → prioritize mitigation measures by RPN.

blocks.zh: RPN = S × O × D，最高分 125（5×5×5），最低分 1。
blocks.en: RPN = S × O × D, with a maximum of 125 (5×5×5) and a minimum of 1.

blocks.zh: RPN 公式
blocks.en: RPN Formula

blocks.zh:
RPN = Severity × Occurrence × Detection

Low:    RPN 1–20   → 標準監控即可
Medium: RPN 24–45  → 需納入比較性研究設計
High:   RPN 48–125 → 需額外緩解措施
blocks.en:
RPN = Severity × Occurrence × Detection

Low:    RPN 1–20   → standard monitoring is sufficient
Medium: RPN 24–45  → include in the comparability study design
High:   RPN 48–125 → additional mitigation required

blocks.zh: 類比說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: FMEA 就像飛機起飛前的系統查核清單（checklist）。每個潛在問題都被打分數，分數越高代表越需要立即處理。PACMP 的設計邏輯是：把分數高的項目轉化為「驗證計畫的必測項目」，讓監管機關看到你的風險有被系統性管理，而不是事後亡羊補牢。
blocks.en: FMEA is like a pre-flight system checklist for an aircraft. Every potential problem is scored, and the higher the score, the more urgently it needs attention. The design logic of a PACMP is to turn high-scoring items into "must-test items" in the validation plan, so the regulator sees that your risks are managed systematically rather than patched up after the fact.

blocks.zh: Table 12-9🔍 — Risk Evaluation to Inform Comparability Study Design — 風險評估驅動比較性研究設計
blocks.en: Table 12-9🔍: Risk Evaluation to Inform Comparability Study Design

blocks.zh: Table 12-9🔍 解析：為何大多數是 M，沒有 H？
blocks.en: Analysis of Table 12-9🔍: Why Are Most Items M and None H?

blocks.zh: 核心邏輯：風險等級由「什麼沒有改變」決定
blocks.en: Core Logic: The Risk Level Is Determined by "What Is Not Changing"

blocks.zh: 這份評估表每一列的 Rationale 都有一個共同的關鍵句：「The filling process is not changing. Primary container closure components are not changing.」
blocks.en: The Rationale in every row of this assessment table contains the same key sentence: "The filling process is not changing. Primary container closure components are not changing."

blocks.zh: 這句話是整個風險論證的支柱——配方沒變、容器密封系統沒變、輸入與輸出沒變。唯一改變的是充填「設備」。因此對純度、填充量、CCI 的影響只是「可能」，而非「必然」。
blocks.en: This sentence is the pillar of the whole risk argument: the formulation has not changed, the container closure system has not changed, and the inputs and outputs have not changed. The only thing that changes is the filling "equipment". The impact on purity, fill volume and CCI is therefore only "possible", not "inevitable".

blocks.zh: 重點提示：為何純度/無菌性是 M 而非 L？
blocks.en: Key Point: Why Is Purity/Sterility M and Not L?

blocks.zh: 純度/無菌性（Purity/Sterility）評為中等風險的原因有兩點：
blocks.en: Purity/Sterility is rated medium risk for two reasons:

blocks.zh: 新隔離器引入了 H₂O₂ 去污染循環，殘留過氧化氫對蛋白質穩定性可能有影響（需額外評估）。
blocks.en: The new isolator introduces an H₂O₂ decontamination cycle, and residual hydrogen peroxide may affect protein stability (additional evaluation is needed).

blocks.zh: 新的蠕動泵（peristaltic pump）取代隔膜泵（diaphragm pump），泵管剪切力對蛋白質完整性有潛在影響（這正是幫浦研究的由來）。
blocks.en: The new peristaltic pump replaces the diaphragm pump, and shear from the pump tubing may affect protein integrity (this is the origin of the pump studies).

blocks.zh: 因此「緩解措施」欄位特別提到：評估殘留 H₂O₂ 影響 + 預過濾生物負擔 + 過濾器完整性測試。
blocks.en: The "mitigation" column therefore specifically mentions: evaluate the effect of residual H₂O₂ + prefilter bioburden + filter integrity testing.
